decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a reliable, portable Bluetooth speaker with high sound quality. My consideration set focuses on well-rated options in the $35-$45 range. I evaluated the JBL Go 3, JBL Clip 3 (Renewed), HyperGear Beast XL, comiso 30W, and the Philips 360-degree speaker. While the HyperGear Beast XL offers more power (30W) and is an 'Overall Pick,' the JBL Go 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_129) stands out due to its extremely high rating (4.7) and consistent positive feedback regarding sound clarity for its size. The brand reputation of JBL for portable audio and the modern IP67 rating make it the most appealing choice for my needs.
